title: Terminology-Driven Product App And Example Names
description: Extend the terminology mechanism so a terminology can rename the product name, app names, and example names — not just window/panel/action labels. Under "reuse": semio -> Entwerfen mit Bestand, puzzle 3d -> Aggregator, Concrete Forest example -> Abbau Aufbau. Add AppDefinition.terminology_documents (terminology id -> full replacement document path), wire it through core/plugin builder/React shell (os-shell.tsx)/wgpu shell, remove the dead AppLabelsOverlay.app_label field, add example_labels overrides for concrete-forest in puzzle 2d/3d/5d.
